name: Smashing Pumpkins

whyMatters.en: Chicago alternative band formed in 1988. Siamese Dream (1993) and Mellon Collie and the Infinite Sadness (1995) stacked multi-track guitar production into mid-90s alt-radio reach.
whyMatters.zh: 芝加哥 alternative 乐队，1988 年成立。《Siamese Dream》（1993）与《Mellon Collie and the Infinite Sadness》（1995）以多轨吉他制作进入 90 年代中期 alt 电台。

note.en: From Siamese Dream; layered guitars under a bright hook.
note.zh: 出自《Siamese Dream》；明亮钩子下的叠轨吉他。

note.en: From Mellon Collie; drum-loop sheen and nostalgia lyric.
note.zh: 出自《Mellon Collie》；鼓循环光泽与怀旧歌词。

note.en: Distortion-chorus rock single from Mellon Collie.
note.zh: 《Mellon Collie》上的失真副歌摇滚单曲。

shortBio.en: Corgan multi-track guitar alt, 1988–. Siamese Dream and Mellon Collie are the peak pair.
shortBio.zh: Corgan 多轨吉他 alt，1988 年至今。《Siamese Dream》与《Mellon Collie》是巅峰双专。

body.en:
The Smashing Pumpkins formed in Chicago in 1988. Butch Vig’s production on Siamese Dream (1993) stacks dense guitar tracks. Mellon Collie and the Infinite Sadness (1995) is a double album with both hard singles and soft radio cuts such as 1979. Late-90s lineup fractures followed; Corgan kept the name active.

Production density is the clearest identifier beside quieter Pixies-style dynamics.

Corgan and James Iha started in Chicago in 1988. The first show used a drum machine, then D’arcy Wretzky, then Jimmy Chamberlin. Gish (1991) was recorded with Butch Vig, later the Nevermind producer. A tour with Pearl Jam and Red Hot Chili Peppers followed. On Siamese Dream (1993) the book says Corgan replaced Wretzky’s and Iha’s parts; Mike Mills played piano. Mellon Collie and the Infinite Sadness (1995) hit US #1. Jonathan Melvoin joined the tour and died of an overdose in July 1996. Chamberlin, who had taken heroin with him, was fired. Matt Walker (ex-Filter) and Dennis Flemion (The Frogs) came in. Adore (1998) uses guest drums from Matt Cameron. Wretzky left in 1999. Melissa Auf der Maur, from Hole, played the 2000 farewell tour.

The 2007 restart on Zeitgeist was Corgan and Chamberlin, plus Jeff Schroeder, Lisa Harriton, and Ginger Reyes. Corgan fired Chamberlin again in 2009. Oceania (2012) uses Nicole Fiorentino and Mike Byrne. Monuments to an Elegy (2014) uses Tommy Lee’s drums; the tour included Mark Stoermer (The Killers) and Brad Wilk. A Simmons line, Chinese-edition wording: the guitars could be as loud as they wanted, and the songs still had pop melodies.
body.zh:
The Smashing Pumpkins 于 1988 年在芝加哥成立。Butch Vig 在《Siamese Dream》（1993）上叠密集吉他轨。《Mellon Collie and the Infinite Sadness》（1995）是双专，既有硬单曲也有《1979》一类软电台曲。90 年代末阵容分裂；Corgan 继续使用乐队名。

制作密度是最清楚的识别点，对照更偏安静动态的 Pixies 写法。

Corgan 与 James Iha 1988 年在芝加哥组建。首演用一台电子鼓，然后是 D’arcy Wretzky，再是 Jimmy Chamberlin。《Gish》（1991）与 Butch Vig 合作，他后来制作《Nevermind》。随后与 Pearl Jam、Red Hot Chili Peppers 一起巡演。书中写《Siamese Dream》（1993）里 Corgan 换掉了 Wretzky 和 Iha 的部分；钢琴是 Mike Mills。《Mellon Collie and the Infinite Sadness》（1995）美国榜首。Jonathan Melvoin 参加巡演，1996 年 7 月服药过量去世。与他一起吸海洛因的 Chamberlin 被开除。Matt Walker（前 Filter）与 Dennis Flemion（The Frogs）加入。《Adore》（1998）的客席鼓包括 Matt Cameron。Wretzky 1999 年离队。来自 Hole 的 Melissa Auf der Maur 参加 2000 年告别巡演。

2007 年《Zeitgeist》重组是 Corgan 与 Chamberlin，加上 Jeff Schroeder、Lisa Harriton 与 Ginger Reyes。Corgan 2009 年再次开除 Chamberlin。《Oceania》（2012）是 Nicole Fiorentino 与 Mike Byrne。《Monuments to an Elegy》（2014）用 Tommy Lee 的鼓；巡演阵容包括 The Killers 的 Mark Stoermer 与 Brad Wilk。中文版所引 Gene Simmons：吉他要多响就可以多响，歌里仍有流行旋律。

title.zh: Alt 电台上的多轨吉他

body.en:
Corgan multi-tracks guitars into shoegaze-adjacent density while keeping verse-chorus radio shapes. Siamese Dream is the studio peak; Mellon Collie expands length and adds softer singles.

Chicago alt competed with Seattle volume through production density as much as grit.
body.zh:
Corgan 把吉他多轨叠到与 shoegaze 相邻的密度，同时保留主副歌电台结构。《Siamese Dream》是录音峰值；《Mellon Collie》扩展篇幅并加入更软的单曲。

芝加哥 alt 与西雅图音量竞争时，制作密度与砂砾感同等重要。

body.en:
Corgan, Iha, D’arcy, and Chamberlin are the silhouette for Siamese Dream and Mellon Collie. Chamberlin exits and returns; later casts rotate heavily.

Mid-90s citation centers on that four.

Vig links Gish to Nevermind. Mills plays piano on Siamese Dream. Cameron drums on Adore. Wilk and Stoermer appear on the 2014 tour.
body.zh:
Corgan、Iha、D’arcy 与 Chamberlin 是《Siamese Dream》《Mellon Collie》的剪影。Chamberlin 离队又回归；后来阵容大量轮换。

90 年代中期引用集中在这四人。

Vig 把《Gish》和《Nevermind》连在一起。Mills 在《Siamese Dream》弹钢琴。Cameron 在《Adore》打鼓。Wilk 与 Stoermer 出现在 2014 年巡演。

alt.en: Billy Corgan with the Smashing Pumpkins, 12 December 1991
alt.zh: Billy Corgan 与 Smashing Pumpkins，1991 年 12 月 12 日

body.en:
Corgan: songwriting and most tracked guitars. Iha: complementary lines. D’arcy: bass and public image. Chamberlin: fusion-leaning power drums.

Studio hierarchy is Corgan-led; live still reads as a four-piece in the peak years.
body.zh:
Corgan：写作与多数叠轨吉他。Iha：互补声部。D’arcy：贝斯与公开形象。Chamberlin：偏融合的强力鼓。

录音室由 Corgan 主导；巅峰期现场仍读作四人。

body.en:
Siamese Dream single. Major-key hook over saturated guitars. Ironic lyric under bright tone.

A mass entry before Mellon Collie’s double-album scale.
body.zh:
《Siamese Dream》单曲。饱和吉他上的大调钩子。明亮音色下的反讽歌词。

《Mellon Collie》双专体量前的大众入口。

body.en:
Drum loop, clean arpeggios, nostalgia lyric. Shows radio range beyond distortion-chorus singles.

The soft face of Mellon Collie.
body.zh:
鼓循环、干净分解和弦、怀旧歌词。显示电台范围超出失真副歌单曲。

《Mellon Collie》的软面孔。

title.zh: 90 年代 alt 制作引用

body.en:
Muse and later arena alt acts cite Corgan’s stacking. Density sits near My Bloody Valentine; hooks near Pixies; mid-90s ambition scale near Nine Inch Nails.

Chicago multi-track maximalism on alt radio.
body.zh:
Muse 与后来的体育场 alt 乐队常引用 Corgan 叠轨。密度靠近 My Bloody Valentine，钩子靠近 Pixies，90 年代中期野心尺度靠近 Nine Inch Nails。

Alt 电台上的芝加哥多轨最大化。

note.en:
Siamese Dream and Mellon Collie peak years.

Melvoin died in July 1996; Chamberlin was fired the same summer. Auf der Maur is the 2000 bass. Later drums are Walker, then Byrne; Lee plays on the 2014 album only.
note.zh:
《Siamese Dream》与《Mellon Collie》巅峰年。

Melvoin 1996 年 7 月去世；Chamberlin 同年夏天被开除。Auf der Maur 是 2000 年的贝斯。后来的鼓是 Walker，然后是 Byrne；Lee 只出现在 2014 年专辑上。

note.en: Layered-guitar single that fixed Siamese Dream on radio.
note.zh: 叠轨吉他单曲；固定《Siamese Dream》的电台位置。

note.en: Multi-track guitar production as a mid-90s alt radio mark.
note.zh: 多轨吉他制作作为 90 年代中期 alt 电台标记。
